notes: ClearLane is a client-side SaaS prototype for customs clearing agents: shipment CRUD with domain validation, customs value and duty/tax calculations, document generation (commercial invoice, packing list, customs entry export) and a clearance status workflow. Ships as a static build with localStorage persistence and seeded demo data. Known limitations: no server-side backend or real auth provider, demo-grade password hashing, illustrative duty rate table only, no live customs API integration.
